questions.stem:
SCIENCE PASSAGE 7: Pendulum Period, Length, and Mass
Students timed 10 swings of pendulums with two bob masses at several string lengths and divided by 10 to obtain period. The release angle was kept small and constant.

Which statement correctly identifies variables in the study?
F) String length and bob mass were varied; period was measured.
G) The measured outcome was held constant in every trial.
H) No condition was intentionally varied or classified.
J) The graph title was the dependent variable.

options.A: String length and bob mass were varied; period was measured.
options.B: The measured outcome was held constant in every trial.
options.C: No condition was intentionally varied or classified.
options.D: The graph title was the dependent variable.

questions.explanation: The correct choice distinguishes the factor varied or classified from the outcome measured.

questions.stem:
SCIENCE MATERIAL SET 4
Students tested how water temperature affected the time required for a tablet to dissolve. They used identical tablets, 103 mL of water in each cup, and stirred each cup at the same rate.

TABLE 1
Temperature (°C) | Dissolving time (s)
10 | 32
20 | 24
30 | 19
40 | 15

Trial 2 repeated the procedure with twice the water volume. Researcher 1 claims that higher temperature increases particle motion and therefore decreases dissolving time. Researcher 2 agrees that temperature matters but claims that stirring rate is the dominant factor whenever stirring is not controlled.

If 20°C is designated the control condition, its purpose is to:
A) eliminate the dependent variable
B) provide a baseline for comparison
C) guarantee Researcher 1 is correct
D) double every measured value
questions.explanation: The keyed response follows the material and directly targets 确定对照组及其作用.
